scope: Public source families; original study geometry. No supplier CAD or source photographs are bundled.

sources.title: Hammond 1444 Series aluminum chassis
sources.used: 1444-8 nominal outside envelope 6 x 4 x 2 inches and aluminum thickness 0.040 inch. Source product is spot welded. Study uses open corner reliefs and omits welded tabs; bend radius and hole layout are authored assumptions.

sources.title: Protolabs sheet metal bend radius guidelines
sources.used: Neutral-axis definition and dependence of K-factor on material and tooling. K=0.42 in this study is an illustrative input requiring coupon calibration, not a supplier-approved value.

sources.title: Protolabs: How and When to Add Bend Reliefs to Sheet Metal Parts
sources.used: Round relief roots help reduce tear and crack propagation. Revision 3 uses authored 0.5 mm root radii at 45-degree miter seams with a 0.5 mm normal gap. Revision 2 used 1.5 mm wide slots with 0.75 mm roots. This source does not certify the study dimensions or miter edge preparation.

sources.title: Mate: strengthening ribs
sources.used: Public rib-forming examples motivate the corrugated shield family. No strength increase is quantified or established by the geometry study.

sources.title: Beckwood: deep drawing
sources.used: The manufacturer distinguishes forming motion, blank holding and material flow, and discusses multiple draws for demanding parts. The stepped housing is a target geometry; its sequence is illustrative and unqualified.
